starterDeckMix.note: Ken, Oct 31: the Warband (default) deck carries 30 Miners (half the deck, never under 28); Miners are at least a third of every other starter deck; the four styles are in tools/gen-starter-decks.py

combat._note: Combat v3 (Ken, Nov 1): Attack = swings, each a d6 that hits on hitFrom or more (2-6 hits, only a 1 misses). Each landed hit is blocked when any of the defender's block dice shows a blockFaces number (a 6): dice = current Health, at most blockCap (2); a unit of cost bigUnitCost (7) or more always rolls bigUnitDice (1); Armored and Riot Shield roll armoredExtraDie (1) more, at most armoredCap (3). A Large unit's attack takes bigAttackerTakesDie (1) away from the defender's block dice, never below 1 (Ken, Nov 1). Commanders roll commanderBlockDice (1). Ranged attacks and abilities use the shown Attack, no halving (Ken, Nov 1). dice 'sure' = tests: every swing hits, nothing blocks.
combat._pauseNote: Ken, Nov 1: milliseconds of pause before every swing (attacks, strike-backs, ranged shots, the computer's too); the hit / miss / block sound and sticker come only when the swing lands.

costFormula._note: Ken, Nov 1: cost = Attack + Health + ability bonus, halved and rounded up; above halfUpTo it climbs overPer per point from overBase; cap, min. Bonus: bigBonus for a big ability, smallBonus for any other, 0 for Miner abilities; only the biggest counts. A card's costOverride (in cards.json) wins over the formula. See src/engine/cost.ts and tools/gen-costs.py.

feetByCost._note: Ken, Nov 1: feet follow the formula cost (an override never changes feet); every Miner walks 1; walls walk wallMove.

_upgradeNote: Ken, Nov 1: a creature takes at most upgradeCap Miner-card upgrades (basic or Smith); spells and auras don't count.
